Aegion is an ESA BIC UK supported advanced materials venture headquartered at Space Park Leicester, UK. We are dedicated to the development and qualification of high-performance materials designed to withstand the harshest frontiers of space exploration and deep-tech industry
Aegion operates at the intersection of metallurgy and aerospace engineering, delivering solutions for environments where traditional materials fail. Our primary application domains include: Space Propulsion: High-temperature superalloys for rocket engines and thrusters, Orbital Assets: Lightweight, high-strength structures for satellites and space stations, Deep Space Exploration: Radiation-hardened materials and thermal protection systems for lunar and Martian missions and Future Energy: Material integrity for Space-based Nuclear Power and Small Modular Reactors (SMRs).
The core of Aegion’s intellectual property lies in Advanced Thermomechanical Process Engineering. Moving beyond simple alloy blending, we manipulate materials at the crystal lattice and microstructural levels to achieve unprecedented performance benchmarks.
Our portfolio is tailored to meet the rigorous qualification standards of the European Space Agency (ESA) and the broader UK space ecosystem:
- Next-Gen Superalloys: Titanium- and Nickel-based systems, including Titanium Aluminides for high-efficiency propulsion components.

- Advanced Composites: Graphene-reinforced metal matrix composites and refractory systems.

- Technical Ceramics: Ultra-high-temperature ceramics (UHTCs) for re-entry shielding and thermal management.

- Atmospheric Management: Metal-Organic Frameworks (MOFs) for advanced carbon capture and life-support systems.

UWRC sp. z o.o. (UWRC Ltd) established in 2012, is the special purpose vehicle (spv) of the University of Warsaw (UW), Poland, which is a sole shareholder of the company. The UWRC Ltd was established to support University researchers and students in indirect commercialization of their scientific activity results (setting up spin-off companies). The company is established to comply with Polish Higher Education and Research legal framework, which allows universities to setup companies and hold shares only through the spv.
The UWRC Ltd offers to students and faculty members a range of services from mentoring, business idea assessment, definition of value proposition, business model development, market validation, monetisation strategies, etc. Since establishment in 2012 the UWRC Ltd supported setting up of more than 30 university based, deep-tech spin-off companies. At present the UWRC Ltd manages a portfolio of more than 20 spin-offs.
The UWRC Ltd offers also to UW students and researchers the preincubation services. It allows sciencepreneurs to develop Proof of Concepts, MVPs and test the market with their early products and services under an umbrella of UWRC Ltd legal entity, without taking a risk of setting up their own ventures. Prio Optics GmbH is a pioneering deep-tech startup based in Eggenstein-Leopoldshafen, Germany, specializing in the development and production of advanced optical coatings using cutting-edge inkjet printing technology. 
Prio Optics leverages proprietary processes to manufacture multilayer optical interference coatings under ambient conditions, eliminating the need for traditional vacuum-based deposition methods. This approach enables cost-effective, scalable, and customizable production of optical coatings on a variety of substrates, including flexible and large-area formats. 
Prio Optics offers a broad portfolio of optical coatings, such as anti-reflection coatings, dichroic coatings, and long-pass filter coatings, catering to applications in smartphone cameras, displays, building window and photovoltaics. 
Prio Optics' inkjet-printed coatings are characterized by higher throughput at lower costs, fast production, low material waste, and minimal environmental impact, aligning with sustainable manufacturing practices.

RC Fornax is a leading engineering consultancy, with over 5 years' experience delivering engineering outcomes across all domains of the UK Defence Sector.
